digo: tendegbwa (Mgombato, glossed 'groundnut; njugu mawe'); tendegwa mawe / njugu mawe (Pakia)

teaser.en: Its seeds are so hard that Swahili calls them 'stone nuts', and they ripen underground like peanuts.
teaser.sw: Mbegu zake ni ngumu kiasi kwamba Kiswahili huziita 'njugu mawe', na huiva chini ya ardhi kama karanga.
teaser.dg: Tembeze ni ngumu sana hata Aswahili anaziiha *njugu mawe*, 'njugu za mawe', na zinaivwa tsini dza njugu karanga.

summary.en: *Tendegbwa* is the Bambara groundnut, a low legume whose hard, round seeds ripen underground. It is a minor crop of sandy soils, eaten boiled.
summary.sw: *Tendegbwa* ni njugu mawe, mmea mfupi wa jamii ya kunde ambao mbegu zake ngumu za mviringo huiva chini ya ardhi. Ni zao dogo la udongo wa mchanga, huliwa likiwa limechemshwa.
summary.dg: *Tendegbwa* ni *Bambara groundnut*, mmea wa jamii ya kunde unaomera photsi photsi, ambao tembeze ngumu za mviringo zinaivwa tsini. Ni mmea unaophandwa chidide kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga, na tembe nkuriwa zichichemuswa.

about.en:
*Tendegbwa* is a low, creeping legume with leaves of three leaflets, growing in a tight rosette close to the ground. Like the peanut, it buries its developing pods in the soil.

Each small, round pod holds one or two very hard, round seeds, cream, red, brown or speckled.
about.sw:
*Tendegbwa* ni mmea mfupi unaotambaa wa jamii ya kunde, wenye majani ya vijani vitatu, unaokua kama duara lililoshikamana karibu na ardhi. Kama karanga, huzika maganda yake yanayokua ndani ya udongo.

Kila ganda dogo la mviringo lina mbegu moja au mbili ngumu sana za mviringo, za rangi ya krimu, nyekundu, kahawia au zenye madoadoa.
about.dg:
*Tendegbwa* ni mmea wa jamii ya kunde unaoambala photsi. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu, na makodza ganamera kpwa fungu ririrogbwirana phephi na tsi. Dza njugu karanga, unazika makakayage ganayokula tsini mwa ulongo.

Chila kakaya ridide ra mviringo rina tembe mwenga au mbiri ngumu sana za mviringo, za rangi ya maziya, za kundu, za rangi ya dongo au za mabara-mabara.

where.en: *Tendegbwa* is a minor crop on sandy soils, where the pods can develop easily underground.
where.sw: *Tendegbwa* ni zao dogo kwenye udongo wa mchanga, ambako maganda yanaweza kukua kwa urahisi chini ya ardhi.
where.dg: *Tendegbwa* ni mmea unaophandwa chidide kpwenye tsi ya mtsanga, phatu ambapho makakaya ganaweza kukula tsini bila shida.

uses.en: The seeds are boiled until soft and eaten.
uses.sw: Mbegu huchemshwa hadi zilainike kisha huliwa.
uses.dg: Tembe nkuchemuswa hadi zikale laini, chisha nkuriwa.

names.en: Digo: *tendegbwa* in Mgombato, which glosses it as 'groundnut'; Pakia gives *tendegwa mawe* or *njugu mawe*. Swahili: *njugu mawe*, 'stone nuts', for their hardness. English: Bambara groundnut. Scientists call it *Vigna subterranea*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *tendegbwa* katika Mgombato, inayolitafsiri kama 'groundnut'; Pakia inatoa *tendegwa mawe* au *njugu mawe*. Kiswahili: *njugu mawe*, kwa sababu ya ugumu wake. Kwa Kiingereza: *Bambara groundnut*. Wanasayansi huuita *Vigna subterranea*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *tendegbwa* kpwenye Mgombato, ambayo inarieleza kukala 'groundnut'; Pakia analavya *tendegwa mawe* au *njugu mawe*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *njugu mawe*, 'njugu za mawe', kpwa sababu tembeze ni ngumu. Kpwa Chingereza ni *Bambara groundnut*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Vigna subterranea*.

reason.sw: Njugu karanga, ambazo pia huiva chini ya ardhi
Kunde, zao jingine la jamii ya kunde la jenasi Vigna
reason.dg: Kunde, mmea wanjina wa Vigna unaolavya tembe za kuriwa

reason.en: Pigeon pea, a fellow farm legume
reason.sw: Mbaazi, mmea mwenzake wa jamii ya kunde shambani
reason.dg: Mbalazi, mmea wanjina wa jamii ya kunde wa mindani
